newsitem.title: USA: Chesapeake says no talks with Amoco, anyone.
newsitem.headline: Chesapeake says no talks with Amoco, anyone.

text.p: Chesapeake Energy Corp has not held talks about the company being taken over by Amoco Corp or anyone else, chief financial officer Marc Rowland told Reuters in a telephone interview.
"We have had no discussions about the sale of the company, other than to confirm that we have had no discussions," said Rowland.
Chesapeake shares topped the most active list on the New York Stock Exchange on talk Amoco was set to buy Chesapeake and traded as high as 8-7/16 before falling back to 7-7/8.
An Amoco spokesman declined to comment on market rumors, which most analysts had in any case discounted.
The management of Chesapeake owns around 42 percent of the company's stock. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
